Name: Make Curry - (JA)
Author: eunj920
Description:
You can make curry powder and Naan. Mod includes five new recipes using it, and three new crops used to make curry powder.

As a non-English speaker, I may be inexperienced in English, so please let me know at any time if you find anything strange name or etc. Of course, bugs, too!

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]New recipes[/size][/font]

Curried bread
Curried rice
Curried soup
Curried udon
Curry
Curry powder
Naan

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]New crops[/size][/font]

Coriander
Cumin
Turmeric

+) Add after hearing the report

- Raffadax Teas and Trees

- PPJA More Recipes

Be sad, I don't know how to compatible these modes with mine. I won't stop you from modifying and using it yourself.
